description: Contract for the Stripe billing runtime that starts Checkout Sessions, opens Billing Portal Sessions, and processes signature-verified webhooks. All membership state changes flow through the Slice 1 membership transitions; Stripe identifiers are never exposed in public API responses.

productionExclusions: Wildcards, empty strings, and non-https URLs are rejected
STRIPE_API_VERSION diverging from the pinned value is rejected
envConfig.sanitization: Environment validation errors never include secret values; sanitized paths return generic hints only

explicitExclusions: Public exposure of Stripe customer, subscription, invoice, or payment identifiers
Storing Checkout or Portal URLs beyond the response body
Direct membership entitlement mutation from routes (only via Slice 1 transitions or the webhook processor)
Additional webhook event types not enumerated above
Trial subscriptions, paused subscriptions, non-annual pricing, or multi-line subscriptions
GraphQL, Redis, or worker-based webhook processing

checkoutSession.auth: session (web cookie or mobile session header) required; SetupGrant/RecoveryGrant/Bearer rejected

customerPortalSession.auth: session (web cookie or mobile session header) required; SetupGrant/RecoveryGrant/Bearer rejected

stripeWebhook.contentTypeParser: application/json parsed as Buffer with rawBody attached
stripeWebhook.signatureFailure: 400 Bad Request without invoking the processor

livemodeContract.production: STRIPE_EXPECTED_LIVEMODE must be true; webhook events and prices must be livemode=true

metadataPolicy: Never contains Stripe secret keys, webhook secrets, or raw signature headers
